item.title: Feds demand university apologize for letting male athlete compete, forcing women's teams to forfeit
item.description: The U.S. Department of Education’s Office of Civil Rights declared that San José State University must resolve its Title IX violations by apologizing to female athletes for allowing a male athlete to play on the women’s volleyball team. #TitleIX #DepartmentofEducation #Trumpadministration #womenssports #transathlete

item.title: Tucker Carlson prompts pushback for praising Saudi Arabia: 'I feel completely comfortable'
item.description: Conservative political commentator Tucker Carlson raised eyebrows among some Christians for claiming in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday that he feels "completely comfortable" in the Islamic kingdom despite his Christian faith. #TuckerCarlson #SaudiArabia #Islam #persecution

item.title: 3 takeaways from Live Action's abortion pill exposé, investigation of Planned Parenthood
item.description: The pro-life watchdog group Live Action says its new undercover video shows Planned Parenthood employees telling a woman she doesn’t need an ultrasound before taking the abortion pill mifepristone. Here are three takeaways from Live Action's new white paper report and video. #LiveAction #abortionpill #Mifepristone #FDA #prolifemovement #ZyklonB #Holocaust

item.title: 5 things to know about the 2026 midterm elections
item.description: The 2026 midterm elections that will determine control of Congress for the last two years of President Donald Trump’s second term are now less than 10 months away. Here are five things to know about this year’s midterm elections. #2026election #Trump #midtermelections #Congress

item.title: Tom Homan says 'hostile rhetoric,' hate against ICE 'must stop'
item.description: Border czar Tom Homan stressed the need for less hostile rhetoric to reduce violence and improve operational efficiency on Thursday as federal agents continue enforcing immigration law in Minneapolis, Minnesota. #TomHoman #ICE #Minneapolis #immigration #TimWalz #JacobFrey

item.title: Shawn Bolz and false prophets: 4 ways data harvesting has been used (part 1)
item.description: For centuries, false prophets have used the same techniques as mentalists and psychics to make educated guesses about their targets. Knowledge of a person’s physical appearance, family or friends can provide an abundance of clues for discussion. Where the facts end, the imagination takes over. #ShaenBolz #falseprophets #prophecy #RobertTilton #PeterPopoff

item.title: Third ex-leader in televangelist Mark Barclay’s church convicted of child sex abuse
item.description: A third minister with Living Word International Church in Midland, Michigan, founded by televangelist Mark Barclay of Mark Barclay Ministries, has been convicted of child sex abuse charges in the last two years. #LivingWordInternationalChurch #Midland #Michigan #MarkBarclay #SexAbuse #Ministers

item.title: Nicki Minaj declares 'God is protecting' Trump at Trump Accounts event, receives 'Gold Card'
item.description: Rapper Nicki Minaj proclaimed that “God is protecting” President Donald Trump as she spoke at an event launching a new economic initiative by the president, revealing later in the day on social media that she has received a Trump Gold Card and is finalizing her U.S. citizenship. #DonaldTrump #NickiMinaj #TrumpAccounts

item.title: CofE priest erupts during election service of first female archbishop of Canterbury: 'I object!'
item.description: An Anglican priest was removed from the formal election service of Dame Sarah Mullally as the first archbishop of Canterbury at St. Paul's Cathedral on Wednesday after he shouted his objection to her confirmation. #ChurchofEngland #SarahMullally #Anglican #UnitedKingdom

item.title: New movement seeks to mobilize churches in push to overturn landmark gay marriage ruling
item.description: A coalition of Christian conservative organizations and leaders has joined a new campaign seeking to mobilize churches to push for the overturning of the 2015 U.S. Supreme Court decision that legalized same-sex marriage nationwide. #SupremeCourt #Obergefell #GreaterThan #LGBT #samesexmarriage #KimDavis
